verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application platform, and portability and lock-in are fair questions for a hosting platform, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence that Render offers or targets standard edge runtime APIs, or that code runs unmodified across multiple edge platforms. The bare 'Docker support' listing is adjacent: it does not claim cross-edge-platform portability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write code against standard runtime APIs so it runs unmodified across multiple edge platforms instead of being locked into proprietary storage/runtime APIs
